name: savvy-progress
description: A progress bar above the prompt and an agents panel (/agents-info) for sub-agent work: one row per task with its sub-agent, gates and cost, a row per sub-agent with its model, the skills it used and a steady creature of its own, and run health. A fork of johnnyvizz's savvy-progress (MIT), with task rows, gate tracking, open-task links and a currency setting added.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel at the start of every session

taskLink.title: Task Link
taskLink.description: Where a task opens when you click Open Task on its row: a web address with {id} where the task's id goes, for example https://app.clickup.com/t/{id}. Leave empty for no open button.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The currency costs are shown in. They are worked out in US dollars from a built-in price table.

exchangeRate.title: Exchange Rate
exchangeRate.description: How much of your currency one US dollar buys, for example 0.76 for pounds. Ignored for USD.
